intents.goal: When someone logs out on a shared computer, the next person must not be able to get into their account. Add a logout(accessToken) to src/sessions.js.
intents.acceptance: After logout(accessToken) the session no longer gives access, and npm test passes.
intents.constraints: The web and mobile apps renew tokens on their own; see docs/sessions.md and src/client.js, which must not change.
